reason: a near-miss collector that flips a Defender setting before reading it is an intervention, not evidence - the read-only (all Get-) rubric row fails on the script text even though both bundles come out looking right (module 04 §4.8)

edit.content:
# make sure real-time protection is on before we collect (DON'T: this mutates the endpoint)
Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring 0
[pscustomobject]@{
  Control_CC6_1_Encryption              = (Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint C:).VolumeStatus
  Control_CC6_8_DefenderEnabled         = (Get-MpComputerStatus).AntivirusEnabled
  Control_CC6_1_ScreenLockTimeoutSeconds = (Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name ScreenSaveTimeOut).ScreenSaveTimeOut
  Control_CC6_1_FailedLogonCount        = (Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4625} -MaxEvents 20).Count
  Control_CC6_3_LocalAdmins             = (Get-LocalGroupMember -Group Administrators).Name
} | ConvertTo-Json > bundle.json
[pscustomobject]@{
  Control_CC6_1_Encryption              = (Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint C:).VolumeStatus
  Control_CC6_8_DefenderEnabled         = (Get-MpComputerStatus).AntivirusEnabled
  Control_CC6_1_ScreenLockTimeoutSeconds = (Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name ScreenSaveTimeOut).ScreenSaveTimeOut
  Control_CC6_1_FailedLogonCount        = (Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4625} -MaxEvents 20).Count
  Control_CC6_3_LocalAdmins             = (Get-LocalGroupMember -Group Administrators).Name
} | Export-Csv bundle.csv -NoTypeInformation
Get-Content bundle.json
